params.name: PageSize
params.description: Maximum number of records returned per request (1-1000, default 100)

params.name: LastId
params.description: Id of the last Classifier object in previously returned collection

params.name: CategoryNames
params.description: Optional comma-delimited list of category names to filter by

params.name: ClassifierTypes
params.description: Optional comma-delimited classifier type filter. Valid values are static aliases: Classifier, Core AI Model, LLM Model, Metadata.

info.name: Get classifier results for conversations based on filter criteria

params.name: DateReference
params.description: Which date to filter on. Valid values: ArrivalDate (default), InteractionDate.

params.name: StartDate
params.description:
ISO 8601 datetime. Required. Requests may span at most 7 days unless at least one of
ClassifierIds, HierarchyIds, HierarchyCodes, ClassifierCategoryNames, or ClassifierTypes
is supplied, in which case up to 31 days is allowed.

params.name: EndDate
params.description:
ISO 8601 datetime. Must be equal to or later than StartDate. Required. The total requested
range may be at most 7 days unless at least one of ClassifierIds, HierarchyIds,
HierarchyCodes, ClassifierCategoryNames, or ClassifierTypes is supplied, in which case up
to 31 days is allowed.

params.name: ClassifierIds
params.description:
Comma-separated list of classifier GUIDs. Use GET /Conversations/Classifiers to discover available IDs.
Providing this filter qualifies the request for the 31-day maximum date range.

params.name: HierarchyIds
params.description:
Comma-separated list of hierarchy GUIDs. Providing this filter qualifies the request for the
31-day maximum date range.

params.name: HierarchyCodes
params.description:
Comma-separated list of hierarchy codes. Resolved to hierarchy IDs automatically. Providing
this filter qualifies the request for the 31-day maximum date range.

params.name: ClassifierCategoryNames
params.description:
Comma-separated category name filter. Valid values: Skills, Topics, Process, SE Suite.
Providing this filter qualifies the request for the 31-day maximum date range.

params.name: ClassifierTypes
params.description:
Comma-delimited classifier type filter. Valid values: Classifier, Core AI Model, LLM Model, Metadata.
Providing this filter qualifies the request for the 31-day maximum date range.

params.name: LastId
params.description: GUID of the last conversation from the previous page. Used for cursor-based pagination.

items.docs:
Returns a list of classifier results for conversations 
with Status of "Sampled" or "ReadyToSample" that match the specified criteria.
            
Requests without any classifier or hierarchy filters may span up to 7 days.
Supplying at least one of ClassifierIds, HierarchyIds, HierarchyCodes,
ClassifierCategoryNames, or ClassifierTypes extends the maximum date range to 31 days.

Returns a list of classifier results for conversations 
with Status of "Sampled" or "ReadyToSample" that match the specified criteria.

Returns the transcriptions for multiple conversations identified by their unique IDs.
Up to 100 conversation IDs are accepted per request. Duplicate IDs are ignored.
            
Response includes:
- transcriptions: successful items
- errors: failed items, each with a statusCode indicating why it failed
  * 404 = conversation not found
  * 400 = failed to process
  * 200 = not processed or still processing (message included)

params.name: conversationId
params.description: GUID of the conversation. Transcriptions are only available once processing is complete. Returns 200 with a message if still processing, 400 if processing failed

items.docs:
Returns the transcriptions for a conversation identified by its unique ID.
If the conversation has not finished processing, returns 200 with a message.
If the conversation failed to process, returns 400 with a message.
